acceptance_rules.resolved: Complete causal trace, supported first divergence, exactly one supported root cause, frozen mapped policy, no prohibited editing, hashes unchanged, no models/test evaluation, all historical/new tests pass, deterministic repeats
acceptance_rules.unresolved: Record evidence gaps and remaining hypotheses; freeze no-approval policy; engineering audit can pass while root-cause resolution remains false

allowed_external_evidence.cache: Freeze one acquisition with original response, source table, normalized output, request parameters and timezone-aware retrieval timestamp; subsequent runs offline
allowed_external_evidence.order: Only after local trace is written
allowed_external_evidence.third_party: Only if necessary, secondary corroboration, never sole authority

approval_rule: Resolved category plus evidence and all engineering acceptance checks; pipeline-bug branch additionally corrected and revalidated; otherwise false

LEGACY_INCOMPLETE_SESSION_SNAPSHOT.required: Reliable legacy incomplete-session evidence and expanded complete-session evidence; do not overwrite either vintage

PIPELINE_PROCESSING_BUG.required: Exact bug location, frozen raw preservation, separate corrected namespace and narrow revalidation; original Stage 13 blocked record remains immutable

UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_DISCREPANCY.required: No expanded downstream approval until missing causal evidence is recovered; preserve both records and original Stage 13 violations

VENDOR_SOURCE_VINTAGE_DRIFT.required: Both original source values, faithful processing, comparable session/source semantics and legacy partial-session possibility excluded; document vintage transition, never splice values

first_divergence_rules: Compare source to downstream ordered layers. If earlier legacy evidence is absent, report first observable mismatch separately and true first causal divergence as not identifiable. Do not label normalized CSV as original vendor raw.
forbidden_interventions: overwrite Stage 1–13 artifacts or original Stage 13 blocked result

investigation_scope.forbidden: No current-vendor comparison of the full 4304-row historical data, new quality protocol, feature/target/split change or performance analysis

legacy_artifact_immutability_rules: Hash all current Stage 1–12 inputs, including already modified data.py; preserve original legacy value and artifacts byte-identically
reproducibility_rules: At least two consecutive formal offline runs on frozen local/external evidence; all deterministic CSV/JSON bytes identical. External timestamp recorded once, never refreshed during reproducibility.

root_cause_decision_rules.LEGACY_INCOMPLETE_SESSION_SNAPSHOT: Reliable contemporaneous timing or source-unfinal evidence proves legacy incomplete at the primary session; lower volume, file mtime and Git commit time are insufficient.
root_cause_decision_rules.PIPELINE_PROCESSING_BUG: Proven same-source processing mismatch or an exact parser/cache/boundary bug causing this discrepancy; require file/function/transformation evidence.
root_cause_decision_rules.UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_DISCREPANCY: Mandatory fallback for absent legacy raw, insufficient acquisition timing, incompatible sources, conflicting evidence or multiple remaining explanations. Absence of incomplete-session evidence is not evidence of completion.
root_cause_decision_rules.VENDOR_SOURCE_VINTAGE_DRIFT: Both original frozen sources differ, each is preserved faithfully, session/source semantics comparable and unresolved legacy partial-session possibility excluded. Current Yahoo is corroboration only.

source_authority_hierarchy.authority: Frozen original Yahoo HTTP response or original yfinance table; normalized CSV named raw is not an original response
Contemporaneous acquisition metadata, query and version/session parameters
Normalized market/parser/dtype/session representation and downstream artifacts
Current Yahoo response as current state only; cannot reconstruct missing legacy evidence
Third-party corroboration only; never sole causal authority

stage13_artifact_immutability_rules: Hash every current Stage 13 artifact, code/test/report; original status INCOMPLETE_OR_BLOCKED and unexpected count 5 remain immutable. Any evidence-proven bug correction uses separate versioned namespace.
